keeper_watch.coverage: Captured Bet365 named-player lines and Grosvenor team-goalkeeper lines from 28 October 2026. Grosvenor results require the registered keeper to play the full 90 minutes with agreeing counts; exceptions stay under review. No historical replay.
keeper_watch.name: Keeper Watch v1

source_extension.exceptions: Replacement keepers, substitutions and disputed counts remain under review; no inferred voids.

selection_rule: compare the latest fixture capture across bookmakers first; retain the highest price per keeper/line/side, then track one starting goalkeeper line per fixture with edge >=5%, price 1.70-3.00, closest to even money; no second bookmaker bet for an already tracked fixture
